review_scope: Read the complete new helper and relevant path/protocol/receipt portions of reproduce_rrc.py and run_rrc_development.py. No helper execution or market/checkpoint read was performed during this static review. Separate earlier B1 numerical auditing by this reviewer is not part of this static review.
checks: Original or declared REPLAY D1 protocol identity is validated; algorithm/data identity fields remain fixed while path/time/replication metadata may change.
User-specified previous-study and EEX-development paths replace historical absolute runtime inputs; hashes must match the fixed approved development bytes.
Offline validation-score selection uses the original larger-shrink exact-tie rule, and PRETRAIN_SELECTION is cross-checked.
Only selected offline pretrain T.* teacher state is used, never the online final teacher. Joint-state receipt hash, canonical teacher hash, shape and float64/finiteness are checked.
File-byte identity and canonical teacher-state identity are recorded separately against the original B1; optional require-original-state fails on a changed teacher.
Five frozen runtime files are copied byte for byte and checked; source/history identities are checked before prepare.
prepare performs no fitting; paths-only checks existence without data/checkpoint content reads and does not claim hash validation. dry-run checks bytes/states but does not execute adaptation.
run is the only path invoking the original runner, with explicit protocol/prepared/helper/state-registry identities and unchanged design checks.
Fresh output and existing-result guards prevent overwrite or silent restart; the preparation deadline is not silently renewed.
The new output records 60 actual streams, 80 prediction series and 20 declared equivalent derived series separately, with 25332 head updates and 480 cells.
Original historical results are not copied into the replay as new experimental outcomes; no confirmation argument or data expansion is introduced.
important_limit: This helper prepares and executes a new SOLID_REPLAY and validates declared completion counts. It does not automatically run the original B1 independent selector/metric audit, which is intentionally bound to the original protocol, phase, D1 metric SHA and freeze. A new replay cannot inherit the original independent PASS; additional replay-specific aggregation/auditing must be explicitly provided and labelled.
